name: Em
description: Em is a young adult architect who lives with their grandmother, cat, and a new dog, seeking an expansive, sun-drenched sanctuary to recharge but highly vulnerable to spatial and olfactory discomfort.
sensory_sensitivities: unpleasant odors and poor air quality
aesthetic_preferences: Expansive, sun-drenched minimalist spaces defined by crisp whites, soft creams, and abundant indoor foliage. Flooded with diffuse natural light, balancing cool polished concrete with the raw warmth of woven rattan and linen.
lifestyle: Designs spaces professionally and requires a quiet, highly restorative home environment to recharge alone after demanding days, while sharing the space with an elderly relative and a pet.
key_requirements: Expansive, open-plan layout with floor-to-ceiling windows and abundant natural light
Strict odor control and high-rate ventilation to manage pet-related allergens (cat and new dog) and olfactory sensitivities
A quiet, low-stimulation private zone for solitary recharging
notes: Living with an elderly grandmother increases the importance of thermal stability and slip-resistant tactile surfaces, while pet ownership demands durable materials and excellent air filtration.
